# distance metric

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:distanceMetric`](gmeow-distanceMetric.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/distanceMetric>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)

The similarity/distance function under which an embedding or index is meaningful — cosine and euclidean disagree about what is 'near', so the metric is provenance, not a detail. Domain-free: carried by [`Embedding`](../classes/gmeow-Embedding.md) and [`VectorIndex`](../classes/gmeow-VectorIndex.md) alike.
